items.title: Risks of Downloading Suspicious Software and Unsafe Browsing Habits

source_refs.note: Unnumbered topic Risks of Downloading Suspicious Software and Unsafe Browsing Habits under 9.1 as printed (PDF 124, printed 120).

blocks.text: Downloading programs or files from unknown websites can harm your computer or steal your information. Some downloads hide viruses or spyware that collect data without permission. Unsafe browsing, such as visiting fake websites or clicking unknown links, can also lead to scams or identity theft. It is important to check sources before downloading and use antivirus tools for extra protection. Safe browsing habits help keep both devices and data secure.
